description_en: Queries the SQL audit logs of an AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeAuditLogRecords接口查询数仓版集群的SQL审计日志
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-audit-log-records --db-cluster-id am-t4nj8619bz2w30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAuditLogRecords

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in a region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the regions and zones supported by AnalyticDB for MySQL, including region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format.
SQL audit logs can be queried only when SQL audit is enabled, and only logs from the last 30 days are supported. If SQL audit is disabled and then re-enabled, only logs generated after re-enabling can be queried
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。
仅当SQL审计状态为开启时，才能查询到SQL审计日志，且只支持查询30天内的SQL审计日志。如果中途关闭了SQL审计，再次打开时，仅能查询到再次打开后的SQL审计日志
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format.

The end time must be later than the start time.
The interval between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 24 hours
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。

查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间。
查询开始时间与查询结束时间的间隔不能超过24小时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the database on which the SQL statement was executed
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to filter SQL statements that contain the specified keyword
parameters.help_zh: 对查询包含目标关键字的SQL进行查询
parameters.name: query_keyword

parameters.help_en:
The type of the SQL statement. Valid values:
DELETE
SELECT
UPDATE
INSERT_INTO_SELECT
ALTER
DROP
CREATE


You can specify only one SQL type per request. If this parameter is not specified, all types are queried
parameters.help_zh:
SQL类型，取值：
DELETE
SELECT
UPDATE
INSERT_INTO_SELECT
ALTER
DROP
CREATE


每次仅允许传入一种类型查询，若该参数为空，默认查询所有类型
parameters.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the SQL statement was executed successfully. Valid values:
true: The SQL statement was executed successfully.
false: The SQL statement failed to be executed
parameters.help_zh:
目标SQL是否执行成功，取值说明：
true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
parameters.name: succeed

parameters.help_en: The IP address and port number of the client that executed the SQL statement
parameters.help_zh: 执行目标SQL的客户端IP地址和端口号
parameters.name: host_address

parameters.help_en:
The order in which the results are sorted by SQL execution time. Valid values:
asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按SQL执行时间进行正序或倒序排序，取值说明：
asc：正序。
desc：倒序
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The username that was used to execute the SQL statement
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of the results based on specified fields. The value is in JSON format and is an ordered JSON array. Compound sorting is performed in the order of the input array. The array contains the Field and Type fields.
Field specifies the field name for sorting. Valid values:
    - HostAddress: the IP address of the client that connected to the database.
    - Succeed: specifies whether the SQL statement was executed successfully.
    - TotalTime: the total execution duration of the SQL statement.
    - DBName: the name of the database on which the SQL statement was executed.
    - SQLType: the type of the SQL statement.
    - User: the username that was used to execute the SQL statement.
    - ExecuteTime: the start time of the SQL statement execution.
Type specifies the sorting type. Valid values:
    - Desc: descending order.
    - Asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
根据指定字段进行排序，格式为JSON，是一个有序JSON数组，按输入数组的顺序进行复合排序，包含Field和Type两个字段。
Field表示需要排序的字段名，取值说明：
    - HostAddress：连接数据库的客户端地址。
    - Succeed：目标SQL是否执行成功。
    - TotalTime：目标SQL的执行总耗时。
    - DBName：执行目标SQL的数据库名称。
    - SQLType：SQL类型。
    - User：执行目标SQL的用户名。
    - ExecuteTime：目标SQL的执行开始时间。
Type表示排序类型，取值说明：
    - Desc：降序。
    - Asc：升序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:
10
30
50
100
If this parameter is not specified, the default value 10 is used
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
10
30
50
100
本参数不填写时，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

DBName.description_en: The name of the database on which the SQL statement was executed
DBName.description_zh: 执行目标SQL的数据库名称

ExecuteTime.description_en: The start time of the SQL statement execution in local time. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
ExecuteTime.description_zh: 目标SQL的执行开始时间，本地时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

HostAddress.description_en: The IP address and port number of the client that executed the SQL statement
HostAddress.description_zh: 执行目标SQL的客户端IP地址和端口号

SQLType.description_en: The type of the SQL statement

Succeed.description_en:
Indicates whether the SQL statement was executed successfully. Valid values:
true: The SQL statement was executed successfully.
false: The SQL statement failed to be executed
Succeed.description_zh:
目标SQL是否执行成功。取值说明：
true：执行成功。
false：执行失败

TotalTime.description_en: The execution duration of the SQL statement. Unit: milliseconds (ms)
TotalTime.description_zh: 目标SQL的执行时长，单位：毫秒（ms）

User.description_en: The username that was used to execute the SQL statement

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
